narrative.intro: Applied Research Solutions has obligated $242M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Applied Research Solutions received 7 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $34.5M. Applied Research Solutions obligations are down 9.4% year over year. Applied Research Solutions drew most spending from the Department of Defense, which obligated $235M. Applied Research Solutions also received obligations from the General Services Administration totaling $6.4M. Applied Research Solutions work is concentrated in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology), which accounted for $223M of obligations, followed by Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $11.9M and Engineering Services at $6.4M. Applied Research Solutions fiscal-year obligations have ranged from $207M in FY21 to $267M in FY25, with FY26 at $242M so far. Applied Research Solutions average award size and the small award count show that FY2026 to date obligations are concentrated in a few, relatively large awards.
